lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of LAME (https://lame.sourceforge.net).
License: LGPL. LICENSE is the package's licence note; COPYING is the GNU LGPL text shipped in the package
(package.json declares "LGPL-3.0"). lame.min.js is copied unmodified from the npm package lamejs@1.2.1.
It is a separate file, loaded on demand by js/exp/melody/export.js only for MP3 export.
